theme: plate time triad RELPATH + ATIME/CTIME/MTIME + HASENV gate

tests.name: base_pick_put
tests.cmd: base root; pick sub/art.bin; put body

weaknesses.title: RELPATH outside base returns absolute with UNDER=0 — easy to publish non-portable keys
weaknesses.detail: Agents that skip RELPATH_UNDER stamp /tmp into plates. No hard REQUIRE-UNDER mode; OK=1 either way.

weaknesses.title: ATIME often equals MTIME on noatime filesystems
weaknesses.detail: Triad collapses; access vs content change indistinguishable. No ATIME_TRUSTED or mount-option probe.
weaknesses.repro: at_eq_mt=1 after write on typical server FS

weaknesses.title: HASENV miss is OK=1 LAST_N=0 vs ATIME miss OK=0
weaknesses.detail: Soft-probe contracts disagree across host ops. Agents cannot uniform-handle optional env vs optional path times.
weaknesses.repro: HASENV missing OK=1; ATIME missing OK=0

weaknesses.title: CTIME is inode status-change not create-time — agents mislabel birth
weaknesses.detail: chmod/chown bump ctime without content edit. No BIRTHTIME/BTIME form. Docs say CHANGETIME but agents still call it create.

weaknesses.title: No single STAT_TIMES / TRIAD form — three probes + hand composite
weaknesses.detail: Verbose for audit stamps; race window between ATIME and MTIME reads.

weaknesses.title: HAS on env names false-friends PATH substring
weaknesses.detail: HAS CUBALC_PATH_FOO PATH → 1. Gate boards must EQS names not HAS.

workarounds: Always check RELPATH_UNDER before publishing keys
Treat atime==mtime as noatime unknown access
Branch HASENV on LAST_N; ATIME on OK
Prefer MTIME for content freshness; CTIME for meta audit only
language_gaps: RELPATH strict-under mode or fail-outside flag
Unified soft-probe OK contract (HASENV vs ATIME)
issues_faced: noatime collapses atime=mtime on this host — documented
selftest 260/260; no language fix this iter
